title: Levuvo SF build report (B3, GB3.4, R6)
description: Handed over with finish_build. The agent's own statements only (G6.1, G6.4); the factory adds facts (commits, results, cost) itself and shows these statements separately from independent findings. deviations is required, an empty list is allowed (GB3.4).

summary.description: What is new, 2-3 plain sentences for the acceptance package.

summary_language.description: BCP 47 tag of the human's language, e.g. de.

deviations.description: Anything done differently from spec or plan, incl. anything built that the spec does not ask for.

env_vars.description: Required environment variables, names only, never values.
